nodes.label: Turbo Engine (os.scandir Scanning)
nodes.rationale: Uses os.scandir to communicate directly with the OS cache so millions of files can be scanned in seconds, instead of slower directory-walking approaches used by classic tools.

nodes.label: Real-Time Feedback via Server-Sent Events
nodes.rationale: Chosen over frozen loading screens so the user sees which folder is being analyzed millisecond by millisecond, implemented with Python generators streaming SSE.

nodes.label: PyWebView Desktop Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Integrates the Flask web server into a native OS window without requiring an external browser.

nodes.label: Scan Control (target directory input + Scan button)
nodes.norm_label: scan control (target directory input + scan button)
